name: Oats with banana and boiled eggs
instructions: Cook the oats in 250 ml water for 4-5 minutes. Top with sliced banana and cinnamon. Serve with two boiled eggs on the side.

name: Vegetable poha with peanuts
instructions: Rinse poha and drain. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add peanuts and vegetables and cook 3 minutes. Add poha, turmeric and salt, mix well and finish with lemon.

name: Moong dal chilla with curd
instructions: Soak moong dal for 4 hours and grind into a batter with ginger and chilli. Spread thin on a hot pan with a little oil and cook both sides. Serve with curd.

name: Paneer bhurji with 2 rotis
instructions: Sauté onion, tomato and capsicum in oil. Crumble in the paneer with turmeric, salt and pepper and cook 3 minutes. Serve with rotis.

name: Idli with sambar and coconut chutney
instructions: Steam idlis for 10-12 minutes. Serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.

name: Masala omelette with whole wheat toast
instructions: Whisk eggs with chopped vegetables and salt. Cook in a lightly oiled pan on medium heat, fold and serve with toasted bread.

name: Greek yogurt bowl with fruit and almonds
instructions: Add yogurt to a bowl, top with chopped fruit, sliced almonds and a drizzle of honey.

name: Tofu scramble with toast
instructions: Crumble tofu. Sauté vegetables in oil, add tofu, turmeric and black salt and cook 4 minutes. Serve with toast.

name: Peanut butter banana toast
instructions: Toast the bread, spread peanut butter and top with banana slices.

name: Vegetable upma with sprouts
instructions: Dry-roast rava. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, add vegetables and sprouts, then 1 cup water. Stir in rava and cook until thick.

name: Banana peanut butter protein smoothie
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Add ice if you like it cold.

name: Besan chilla with mint chutney
instructions: Mix besan with water, vegetables and spices into a pouring batter. Cook thin pancakes on a lightly oiled pan and serve with mint chutney.

name: Dal, rice and mixed vegetables
instructions: Pressure-cook dal with turmeric and temper with cumin and garlic. Serve with rice, vegetable curry and a fresh salad.

name: Rajma chawal with salad
instructions: Soak rajma overnight, pressure-cook and simmer in an onion-tomato gravy. Serve over rice with salad.

name: Grilled chicken with brown rice and broccoli
instructions: Marinate chicken with lemon, garlic and pepper. Grill 6-7 minutes per side. Serve with brown rice and steamed broccoli tossed in olive oil.

name: Paneer tikka quinoa bowl
instructions: Marinate paneer and vegetables in spiced curd for 20 minutes. Grill or pan-roast until charred. Serve over quinoa.

name: Chole with 2 rotis
instructions: Simmer boiled chickpeas in onion-tomato masala for 15 minutes. Serve with rotis and salad.

name: Chicken curry with rotis and salad
instructions: Cook chicken in onion-tomato masala until tender. Serve with rotis and salad.

name: Fish curry with rice
instructions: Simmer fish pieces in a tangy tomato or coconut gravy for 10 minutes. Serve with rice and salad.

name: Tofu vegetable stir-fry with brown rice
instructions: Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden. Add vegetables, garlic and soy sauce and stir-fry 4 minutes. Serve with brown rice.

name: Curd rice with sprouts salad
instructions: Mix cooled rice with curd and salt. Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves. Serve with sprouts salad.

name: Egg curry with rice
instructions: Prepare a simple onion-tomato gravy, add halved boiled eggs and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: Soya chunk pulao with raita
instructions: Soak soya chunks in hot water and squeeze. Sauté with whole spices and vegetables, add rice and cook. Serve with raita.

name: Moong dal khichdi with curd
instructions: Pressure-cook rice and moong dal with turmeric and vegetables. Add a teaspoon of ghee and serve with curd.

name: Grilled chicken salad
instructions: Grill seasoned chicken breast and slice. Toss vegetables with olive oil, lemon and pepper and top with chicken.

name: Palak paneer with 2 rotis
instructions: Blanch and puree spinach. Cook with onion, garlic and spices, add paneer cubes and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with rotis.

name: Vegetable moong dal khichdi with salad
ingredients: 1.3 bowls moong dal khichdi with vegetables
instructions: Pressure-cook rice, moong dal and chopped vegetables with turmeric and cumin. Serve with salad.

name: Grilled fish with vegetables and sweet potato
instructions: Season fish with turmeric, chilli and lemon and grill 4-5 minutes per side. Serve with sautéed vegetables and boiled sweet potato.

name: Tofu vegetable curry with quinoa
instructions: Simmer tofu and vegetables in a light tomato gravy. Serve with quinoa.

name: Egg bhurji with 2 rotis
instructions: Sauté onion and tomato, add beaten eggs and scramble until set. Serve with rotis and salad.

name: Dal tadka with rotis and bhindi
instructions: Temper cooked dal with cumin, garlic and red chilli. Serve with rotis and dry bhindi sabzi.

name: Chicken vegetable stir-fry with roti
instructions: Stir-fry chicken strips until cooked, add vegetables and spices and cook 3 minutes. Serve with a roti.

name: Paneer vegetable stir-fry
instructions: Toss paneer cubes and vegetables in a hot pan with garlic and pepper for 5 minutes.

name: Moong dal soup with brown rice and vegetables
instructions: Cook moong dal thin like a soup with ginger and cumin. Serve with brown rice and sautéed vegetables.

name: Mutton curry with rice
instructions: Slow-cook mutton in onion-tomato masala until tender. Serve with rice.

name: Chickpea vegetable salad bowl
instructions: Toss chickpeas with chopped vegetables, olive oil, lemon and chaat masala.

name: Roasted chana
instructions: Eat as is, or toss with chaat masala and lemon.

name: Sprouts chaat
instructions: Steam sprouts for 3 minutes (optional), then toss with vegetables, lemon and chaat masala.

name: Curd with apple
instructions: Mix chopped apple into curd and sprinkle cinnamon.

name: Boiled eggs with pepper
instructions: Boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and season.

name: Apple with almonds
instructions: Slice the apple and eat with almonds.

name: Roasted makhana
instructions: Roast makhana in ghee on low heat for 6-8 minutes until crunchy, then season.

name: Paneer tikka bites
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes for 15 minutes and grill or air-fry for 8 minutes.

name: Whey protein shake with milk
instructions: Shake or blend until smooth. Good after a workout.

name: Apple with peanut butter
instructions: Slice the apple and dip in peanut butter.

name: Dhokla with buttermilk
instructions: Serve dhokla with a glass of masala buttermilk.

name: Chicken tikka
instructions: Marinate chicken for 30 minutes and grill or bake at 220°C for 15 minutes.

name: Hummus with vegetable sticks
instructions: Cut vegetables into sticks and serve with hummus.

name: Banana with peanut butter
instructions: Slice the banana and top with peanut butter.
